references.title: Padre y esposa de Kanifaido
references.character_design: Father: short GOLD/charcoal feather ring, six cream curved PAPER pendants and red/black seeds, charcoal cheek arcs, short raw-bark cream hip wrap with RED front zigzag, no nose pin. Wife: pale quill nasal ornament, TWO short cobalt feather ear tufts, red/black seed choker, below-knee raw-fibre dress with dark triangular neck trim and ochre hem. Clearly different faces and age.

references.title: Joyareño y Buynaiyarai · familia de Rikoño
references.character_design: Joyareño wide-cheek face, shoulder black hair, plain cream below-knee garment with a large RED/charcoal FRONT zigzag, bare head, pale quill nasal ornament, brown/red seed strand. Father: LOW dark/green feather crown, four sparse cream curved pendants, narrow bark cover with ochre cord, no nasal pin. Mother: short grey-black chin hair, plain cream longer garment with ochre neck edge, TWO tiny red feather EAR tufts, a small pale nose quill, sparse black/cream seed strand. Infant is a separate H14, never a school-age child.

references.title: Kïtobeo y hermana de Kïtobeni
references.character_design: Kïtobeo father: SHORT emerald/charcoal feather ring with ONE golden accent, sparse six cream tooth-shape PAPER pendants / red-black seeds, short cream raw-fibre hip wrap with BIG black FRONT diagonals, one small pale nose quill, broad lined face and long grey-black hair. Sister: bare head, straight black blunt chin hair, cream KNEE-length garment with RED triangular neck trim and uneven ochre hem, red/black seed choker, small cobalt EAR feather tuft, no nose ornament.

references.title: Gente acuática · modelo comparativo Muinane
references.character_design: Distinct adult human water people, not fish hybrids: first adult bare head and pale nose quill, short cobalt EAR tuft / black-red seeds; second adult LOW emerald/charcoal feather band, two cream curved pendants, no nose pin. Cream raw-fibre garments have different simple dark FRONT trim and small blue-grey / ochre accents, no uniform mythical sea-people robe. Never put ornaments on actual fish support.

references.title: Familia de Yiida · eje del intercambio
references.character_design: Four distinct adults: father elder long grey-black hair / LOW emerald feather ring / cream pendants / charcoal FRONT hip-wrap diagonals; Monaya Jurama short grey-black hair / narrow RED upright tuft / simple seeds / tan bark flaps; mother short black-grey hair / plain ochre-front cream below-knee raw fibre garment / tiny cobalt EAR feather and fine pale nose quill; sister chin black hair / cream KNEE garment with RED neck chevron / bare head / short red-black seed choker. Full warm-brown faces differ in age, shape, brow, nose and lips, no matching crowns or identical dress.

references.title: Tronco que crece y se vuelve piedra
Hombre de frutas
references.character_design: Hombre de frutas: tall slim build, long tapered face, deep warm brown skin PAPER, pronounced brow, straight chin-length black hair. A narrow fibre headband with TWO golden-yellow feathers pointing BACKWARD, small paired dark-seed earrings, a short alternating red/black seed necklace. Narrow cream bark flaps with one muted terra-red edge. Short pale QUILL nasal pin. Original TWO small charcoal cheek dots rather than copied facial pattern. Yellow/red accent identity, no green fan.

references.title: Jitoma agricultor
references.character_design: Jitoma agricultor: tall lean athletic man, diamond high-cheek face, broad natural nose, thick brows, straight black chin-length hair with blunt forehead fringe. A short GOLDEN-YELLOW upright tuft of FOUR feathers on thin woven band and one dark-blue feather at side; narrow bark front/back cover, original small terracotta chevron PAPER across upper chest and separate charcoal forearm band. Sparse black seed necklace with one red seed centre. No nasal ornament. Golden sunlight identity, distinct from long-haired green hunter.

references.title: Fïboi
references.character_design: Fïboi: slender young man, softer oval face, broad mouth, naturally distinct narrower brows, straight black hair to shoulders. LOW charcoal feather circlet with THREE cobalt-blue feathers at one side, a short pale quill nasal ornament, a dark-seed neck strand with one tiny cream disc, narrow pale bark cover with plain waist cord. TWO charcoal horizontal cheek lines separated by unpainted skin. Deep BLUE / cream identity, no white skin or glowing eyes.

references.title: Monaya Jitoma / Jobiya
references.character_design: Jobiya: sturdy mature man, LONG rectangular face, heavier natural nose, black shoulder hair parted centrally. Broad ochre fibre headband with THREE RED feathers angled backward, narrow brown bark loincover, pale sparse tooth-shape PAPER neck pendants, two original sweeping charcoal cheek arcs and vertical chin line. No nasal pin. A single white upper-arm-paper stripe, scarlet / charcoal identity, no green corona.

references.title: Buinaima
references.character_design: Buinaima: mature broad-faced elder, wide natural nose and lined mouth, grey-black shoulder hair. Modest short GREEN feather ring with FOUR golden-yellow upward feathers. Sparse alternating black-seed / cream pendant necklace, small pale quill nasal ornament. Cream knee-length raw fibre hip wrap with two dark FRONT zigzags and an ochre waist-paper edge. Separate white shoulder-paper strips and fine original charcoal cheek arcs, no white glowing skin or celestial mask.

references.title: Buinaiño · niña de la coca
references.character_design: The fully CLOTHED ten-year-old coca girl retains modest cream short-sleeve knee-length fibre tunic and natural fictional child face. ONLY a simple red-and-black seed bracelet and one very small yellow feather tied onto a cream hair string at SIDE, no adult choker, heavy crown, septum or lip ornament. Entire body covered, no real child likeness. Soft green / tiny red identity.

references.title: Nofïda / Nopïda Jitoma
references.character_design: Nofïda / Nopïda Jitoma: lean young man with elongated cheekbones, wide lips, heavy natural brows, straight shoulder black hair. HALF-HEIGHT emerald ring with a SINGLE long cobalt feather to rear, no huge fan. Small black-seed earrings, short red/black seed neck strand, narrow cream bark cover with one charcoal irregular edge. No nasal ornament. One red chest stripe and two fine black cheek curves. Green / cobalt identity, distinct from the father red tuft and brother yellow/blue swept plume.

references.title: Fïzido / Iaijenima
references.character_design: Fïzido / Iaijenima: shorter slim youthful adult, rounded wide-cheek face, fuller lips, straight chin-length black hair with uneven blunt fringe. A LOW swept-back feather comb of three cobalt and TWO golden feathers, slender pale QUILL nasal ornament and ONE short red/black seed neck strand. Narrow cream bark front/back flaps, plain cord. A short charcoal cheek stroke and small pale upper-arm paper stripe. Playful lively natural expression, not a smirk caricature, blue / yellow identity.

references.title: Juma · anciano
references.character_design: Juma elder: very slim aged body, LONG lined narrow face, straight grey CHIN hair. Preserve source GREEN LEAF waist garment with overlapping whole paper leaves, not standard cream loincloth. ONE small cobalt feather earring and fine pale QUILL septum pin, no large crown or necklace. Optional complete long WHITE feather-paper cape rests by him, if requested. Green / white / tiny cobalt identity; same identifiable face and eyes across age/gender transformations, no mandatory crown for child state.

references.title: Kanifaido
references.character_design: Kanifaido: solid young adult man, broad rounded face, wider mouth and nose, straight blunt SHORT black hair. LOW short emerald/charcoal feather ring, a sparse red/black seed choker with four curved cream PAPER pendants, cream knee-length fibre wrap with BIG FRONT charcoal double chevron and red uneven lower edge. ONE small pale nose quill and separate white-paper upper-arm strips. Emerald/red identity, no violent trophy or sexual anatomy. Fragile repaired state removes heavy crown.

references.title: Rikoño
references.character_design: Rikoño adult woman: broad round-cheek face, small natural mouth, wide nose, straight long black hair to WAIST with blunt forehead fringe, healthy sturdy silhouette distinct from narrow Jaguar Daughter. Loose cream raw-bark KNEE-LENGTH garment with BIG original charcoal diamond/front triangular borders and warm OCHRE side PAPER panels, plain back, cut fringe. A LOW small COBALT-blue feather tuft on simple ochre woven band, a fine slender pale QUILL nasal ornament, TWO short red/black and cream/brown seed neck strands with THREE curved pale PAPER pendants. Two original charcoal cheek swirls and fine chin line. Blue/ochre identity, no huge modern chaquira poncho. Bird state can retain proposed ornaments only where source actually mentions them.

references.title: Jadomacuriño
references.character_design: Jadomacuriño: sturdy mature woman with broad angular long face, straight black SHORT chin hair, cream loose raw-fibre BELOW-KNEE garment with RED/charcoal asymmetric FRONT paper band and short uneven fringe, plain back. Simple fibre hairband with FOUR short red feathers to one side, two black-seed ear pendants, slender small pale QUILL nasal ornament. One short seed necklace of brown/cream pieces, ONE charcoal sweeping cheek stroke. Red/brown identity with distinct body and hair from Rikoño.

references.title: Jidobe · presencia de gente
references.character_design: Jidobe human editorial aspect: mature broad sturdy man, long grey-black shoulder hair, angular aged face. A NARROW tall tuft of TWO scarlet feathers and ONE dark-gold feather on fibre base, short pale quill nasal ornament, sparse black/cream seed strand and ONE pale curved pendant. Narrow bark flaps with ochre lower edge. Two fine charcoal jaw strokes. Scarlet/ochre silhouette, complete monkey support remains separate without human ornaments or wings.

source_limits: 18 documented-core route adaptations plus 3 limited Hugo Niño literary summaries explicitly marked as original editorial interpretations. Route 59 is not attributed to Huitoto by located source and remains excluded.
